title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30384: expose planning suggestions variable
summary: The IncludePlanningSuggestions variable on the Item Availability by Event page is now accessible to page extensions through protected scope.
key_points: Variable moved from private to protected scope
Enables page extensions to access planning suggestions setting
No behavior change, only visibility adjustment
Supports extensibility for custom page modifications
quote: Page extensions need access to the setting that controls whether planning suggestions are included on the Item Availability by Event page.
